abilities.descEn: Rangers with this Ability have a high chance of activating Persistence when defeated. Persistence allows these Rangers to hold on for 5 more seconds with a big ATK increase.
abilities.descZh: 擁有此能力的Ranger在被打倒時有高機率發動效果。 Ranger在發動「毅力」之後的5秒內都不會被打倒，且攻擊力會大幅提升。

abilities.descEn: When the Ranger is defeated, it will randomly take 1 of the enemies with it. It has a high chance of activating in PVP and Guild War only, and will not activate in other battles. (Guardians will not be affected by this Ability)
abilities.descZh: 擁有此能力的Ranger被打倒時，會帶著隨機1名敵人同歸於盡。此技能僅會在PVP和公會戰中以高機率發動，其餘戰鬥中則不會發動。（隨機選擇對象不包含守護者）

abilities.descEn:
Rangers with this Ability won't be affected by change effects.
Size change effects cannot be prevented.
abilities.descZh:
持有這個能力的Ranger不會受到變身效果影響。
無法抵擋尺寸變更的變身效果。
